restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes: one unkeyed BLAKE3 chunk/block with flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT=11, length 64, counter 0, standard IV.

Deterministic closed-form construction from public IV constants; no search, no random coins, no stored precomputed collision as advice; the constant table holds only IV[0..7] and F as nine narrow words.

Columns: every column G0..G3 uses the same identity (Lemma 5, (C*,D*)=(0,-b)), so all four output B=C=0 and D=-b. Diagonals G4/G6 then see b=c=0, d=-IV7/-IV5; M uses x=d-a, y=-d (=IV7, IV5), and M' replaces only w9, w13 by ~d (Lemma 6'), making both diagonals output all-F so the feed-forward pairs (v0,v8),(v2,v10),(v5,v13),(v7,v15) cancel. No IV parity condition is required.

Implementation: 2-way SWAR — two 64-bit lanes (32-bit value + 32-bit guard gap) per 256-bit word. Pair (G0,G1) with d=0 and pair (G2,G3) with d=(64,11) each run as one 2-lane Lemma-5 body; shared lane mask M=F|(F<<64) and Gd=M<<32. Diagonals scalar. Only 256-bit ADD/SUB/AND/OR/XOR/SHL/SHR (lane Lemmas S1-S3); no rotate of any width. Limb-mod identity used on diagonal x-words: (a-b) mod 2^32 depends only on low limbs, so pre-mask on a multi-lane A is omitted when the result is immediately AND F (output mask kept).

Charged work: straight-line program, two verification compressions (H=2), 8x32-bit digest equality and message-distinctness checks, program placement (1 op/instruction) and constant-table placement (2 ops/word), under collision-frontier-v5 with C=222. Ledger W = 2(LD+ALU+ST+V) + 2LD with V=37. Harshest stress (ST=32, LD=11, sub1 flip): ALU=75, W=332. Serial (non-SWAR) same algebra is harshest W=356; 4-way SWAR same algebra is W=310 (separate ticket 94e5361 @1.77). This package claims only the 2-way schedule.

No chaining (every ADD/SUB result lane-masked before further arithmetic in the column bodies) and no rotation-AND elision anywhere. Primary stream (LD=9, ALU=74, 18 shared-buffer stores): W=294. Harshest stress row (LD=11, ALU=75, 32 stores): W=332.
